title: Improved semidefinite programming bounds for the maximum $k$-colorable subgraph problem
summary: We study the maximum $k$-colorable subgraph (M$k$CS) problem, which consists in finding a largest $k$-colorable induced subgraph in a given graph. We consider a Semidefinite Programming (SDP) relaxation for the M$k$CS problem and regard its resulting upper bound as a graph parameter. We present several properties of this graph parameter, from which we obtain that the M$k$CS problem is solvable in polynomial time for $k$-perfect graphs.
